grader.scenario: High latency and packet loss affecting competitive gaming server connection
grader.notes: Gaming latency and packet loss call handled by Beth. Customer experienced peak evening ping spikes and packet loss to Frankfurt servers. Agent diagnosed BGP transit peering congestion and successfully re-routed traffic to Telehouse North, but breached Dead Air with two unmanaged 30s+ gaps, omitted security verification entirely, and asked a repeat question on connection medium.
